card.statement: The BRST formulation of $W$-algebras works for an arbitrary good $\Z$-gradings without the assumption of ``even". One needs to add an additional ``neutral fermion" tensor factor to $\brst$ which corresponds to the presence of nonzero $\ga_{-1}$ (cf. <<cite:KRW, DHK>>). Again here, one has the flexibility of choosing a Lagrangian/isotropic subspace $\lag$ of $\ga_{-1}$ in defining the modified BRST complex.
card.label: Remark 22

paper.title: Nilpotent orbits and finite $W$-algebras
paper.abstract: In recent years, the finite W-algebras associated to a semisimple Lie algebra and its nilpotent element have been studied intensively from different viewpoints. In this lecture series, we shall present some basic constructions, connections, and applications of finite W-algebras.
